title: Trigonal bipyramidal Co2III Dy3 cluster exhibiting single-molecule magnet behavior

material_class.structural_family: trigonal bipyramidal Co2Dy3 (OH)6 cluster chain linked by Na

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (0.175 g, 0.4 mmol), Co(NO3)2·6H2O (0.116 g, 0.4 mmol) and sodium propionate (0.096 g, 1.0 mmol) was dissolved in 2 mL deionized water, 2 mL acetonitrile and 6 mL ethanol, then half a drop of hydrogen peroxide (30 wt%) was added. The solution was stirred for 10 hours. Olive green crystals were obtained after evaporation at room temperature for about three weeks (yield 46.5% based on Dy).
synthesis.time: stirred 10 h; evaporated about three weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution stirring followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Olive green crystals obtained by evaporation at room temperature for about three weeks.

properties.summary: Compound 1 is an SMM: χMT at 300 K is 38.59 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 42.51 for three uncoupled DyIII); it decreases to 17.19 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Curie–Weiss fit gives C = 39.07 cm3 mol−1 K and θ = −3.98 K. Magnetization at 2 K reaches 15.2 Nβ at 7 T, well below 30 Nβ, and M vs H/T curves do not superimpose, indicating anisotropy. Zero-dc-field ac susceptibility shows slow relaxation (frequency-dependent peaks 2–11 K). Orbach-only Arrhenius fit: Ueff/kB = 58.8 K, τ0 = 1.03×10−7 s. Combined Orbach+Raman+QTM fit: Ueff/kB = 60.3 K, τ0 = 9.6×10−8 s, C = 0.65 s−1 K−n, n = 3.2, τQTM = 0.0074 s. Cole–Cole α = 0.01–0.21.
